lemma.full_rank_conclusion: If rank H_{t,j}(v)=j+1, the v10 canonical monic gcd over all nonzero maximal minors is (Z+c)^(j+1), with the single finite root Z=-c.
lemma.hypothesis: The full stored syndrome vectors satisfy u=c v for some c in F_17^32.
lemma.m3_no_tail_caveat: For every A in 385..426, t+j=(A-256)+(512-A)=256, exactly the stored syndrome length.  Thus the proportionality needed for tangent payment is the full syndrome relation, not merely a proper visible prefix relation.
lemma.minor_identity: For every maximal row set R, Delta_R(Z)=(Z+c)^(j+1) det(H_R(v)).
lemma.rank_deficient_conclusion: If rank H_{t,j}(v)<=j, every maximal regular minor vanishes; this is a singular bucket for M5 pivots or a separate paid classification.
lemma.tangent_subtraction: At Z=-c the full stored syndrome u+Zv is zero, so the root is paid by the tangent/common-code-line ledger and the residual aperiodic numerator is 0.

nonclaims: does not prove every rank-deficient proportional bucket is contained
does not replace M5 pivot charts for arbitrary rank-deficient data
not a worst-case support-wise MCA row bound
